transcript:
# Public Celebrations Committee

## Meeting minutes

September 21, 2026

Room 205 Town Hall

Attending: Whitney Moody, Mykill Germond, Larry Russo, Ruth Palmer, Jackee Macnamee, Barbara Kapi, Erin Benham, Brenda Schuler, Roz Gallagher, Liz Landow

- Chairman Roz Gallagher called the meeting to order at 5:30 p.m.
- Whitney and Mykill seconded and approved the minutes from the last meeting.
- Treasurer Larry Russo reported a balance of $31,541.89 in our account with a warning that the prices we face now are at an increase over last year.
- Roz reported that the 9/11 memorial in front of the town hall was well attended and well received.

## Halloween: The following report were made for the October 23rd event

- Brenda created a flyer for distribution
- The police and fire depts. are on board with the event.
- Johnny Roz will provide 6 vignettes for the night with a small increase of $3100
- Mary Ellen Eckles and her performing characters are will updated with Star Wars, Toy Story.
- The Halloween banner is missing, but will be hunted up by Roz
- Geremia's will have the pumpkins ready by October 21st for carving
- Lyman Orchards will provide the cider and donuts for refreshment, 1200 being ordered
- All in all we are in good shape for the festivities.

## Seasons of Celebration, December 5th

- Erin Benham has contacted LHHS, Voag dept., for help with the petting zoo
- Jackee Macnamee came up with a great suggestion of ordering plush reindeer from Oriental Trading. Barbara Kapi will advise Sean of Park & Rec to order them asap.
- Krafty Kakes will make the chocolate chip and M&M cookies when we are closer to the date
- Reviewing the task sheet shows that we are in good shape, submitted by B. Kapi, sec.
